mainEntity.name: Can AI-generated SQL be trusted in production?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be useful, but not blindly trusted. Analysts should validate joins, assumptions, null handling, and query plans before production use, especially for financial or executive reporting.

mainEntity.name: Which tools support governed enterprise SQL workflows?

acceptedAnswer.text: ThoughtSpot, Databricks Genie, and Snowflake Cortex Analyst are strong options for governed SQL workflows because they align with enterprise warehouse controls and semantic models.

mainEntity.name: How do AI-native tools differ from SQL copilots?

acceptedAnswer.text: SQL copilots help generate and refine queries with human steering. AI-native tools can execute multi-step analysis from a goal, preserve process history, and retain reusable context for future runs.

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to evaluate SQL AI tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Run the same three SQL tasks across each tool: one aggregation, one multi-table diagnostic query, and one recurring KPI update. Score each tool on correctness, transparency, and repeatability.
